description: Grok CLI hook wiring (experimental adapter, not a 0.4.3 release target). Only events listed in ~/.grok/docs/user-guide/10-hooks.md and tool names proven this session are wired: PreToolUse command guards on Bash|run_terminal_command (10-hooks.md alias table plus live toolName). Handlers are type:command with timeout in seconds and ${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT} expansion. Write-scan, Stop, SessionStart, and Claude-transcript / Codex-rollout readers stay unwired (no captured Grok payload for those events).
